{{- /* OPM override of Hextra's llms.txt (v0.13.0, pinned in overrides.sha256).
       Each entry prints the page's description (required on every page)
       instead of its summary: the summary of a page that holds only a
       planning comment is that comment, and plainify ends a tag at the first
       ">", so a brief with ">=" or "->" would leak its tail here. */ -}}

{{ end }}

{{- end }}
